description: This PHP source file defines a class 'PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring the left menu in the HRM system's PIM module, specifically for determining if a 'My Info' menu item should be shown based on the authenticated user's employee number and request attributes.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the menu items for the PIM left menu, setting specific menu items based on user context and request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures and returns a 'My Info' menu item if the authenticated user matches the employee number in the request; otherwise, it overrides the screen view to 'viewEmployeeList' and returns null.
